Definition: from G2596 and G2545; to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly:--burn (up, utterly).
BiblicalUsage: To burn up is to consume wholly, and John the Baptist says the chaff will be burned with unquenchable fire while the wheat is gathered in. Paul says a man's work may be burned and he himself saved, yet so as by fire, and Babylon is burned in a single day. The fire tests everything, and what is not built on Christ does not survive it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's fire is both judgment and mercy, because it burns away what cannot last and leaves what is real. I hold that I want my work to survive that fire, and the only way is to build it on Christ.
